title: Simplicity of eigenvalues for elliptic problems with mixed Steklov-Robin boundary condition
summary: This paper investigates the spectral properties of two classes of elliptic problems characterized by mixed Steklov-Robin boundary conditions. Our main objective is to prove that, for a generic domain, all the eigenvalues are simple. This result is established by employing domain perturbation techniques and analyzing the transversality of the associated operators.
